Context\\\",\\n        \\\"2. Decision\\\",\\n        \\\"3. Consequences\\\",\\n        \\\"2. Decisions\\\",\\n        \\\"1984 Revisited\\\",\\n        \\\"1.2. Context\\\",\\n        \\\"2) Decision\\\",\\n        \\\"Context\\\",\\n        \\\"1.\\\",\\n        \\\"1)\\\",\\n        \\\"10. Context\\\",\\n    ];\\n    for c in cases {\\n        println!(\\\"{:?} -> {:?} (normalized: {:?})\\\", c, strip_ordinal(c), normalized(c));\\n    }\\n    assert_eq!(normalized(\\\"1. Context\\\"), normalized(\\\"Context\\\"));\\n    assert_eq!(normalized(\\\"2. Decision\\\"), normalized(\\\"Decision\\\"));\\n    assert_ne!(normalized(\\\"2. Decisions\\\"), normalized(\\\"Decision\\\"));\\n    assert_eq!(strip_ordinal(\\\"1984 Revisited\\\"), \\\"1984 Revisited\\\");\\n    println!(\\\"all assertions passed\\\");\\n}\\nEOF\\nrustc -o /tmp/test_strip /tmp/test_strip.rs 2>&1 && /tmp/test_strip\"}"
